metadata.question: Through the months of December 2018 and January 2019, did northern part of Madagascar (between latitude of -12 to -15) recieve less rain than the long-term average for the same two-month period from 2000 to 2019?

- Period: Target = Dec 2018 and Jan 2019. Climatology = seasons Dec(Y)+Jan(Y+1) for Y=2000..2018.
- Location: Madagascar country polygon intersected with latitude band [-15, -12] (northern Madagascar).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Validate image collections have data (size > 0). If not, try fallback. If still none => C1.
- Count valid pixels after processing (Reducer.count). If 0 => C2.
- Check numeric results are finite (not null/NaN) => else C3.
- Compare target 2-month mean vs climatology mean; A if less, B otherwise.

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0');
    const mad = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Madagascar')).geometry();
    const latBand = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -15, 180, -12], null, false);
    const aoi = mad.intersection(latBand, ee.ErrorMargin(1));

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Checks
    const chirpsMonthly = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/Monthly');
    const chirpsDaily = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY');

    const dec2018Col = chirpsMonthly
      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2018, 2018, 'year'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(12, 12, 'month'))
      .filterBounds(aoi);
    const jan2019Col = chirpsMonthly
      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2019, 2019, 'year'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1, 1, 'month'))
      .filterBounds(aoi);

    const decCount = await dec2018Col.size().getInfo();
    const janCount = await jan2019Col.size().getInfo();

    console.log(`AOI: Madagascar ∩ lat[-15,-12]`);
    console.log(`CHIRPS-Monthly Dec2018 imgs: ${decCount}, Jan2019 imgs: ${janCount}`);

    // Target 2-month total (prefer Monthly; fallback to Daily sum)
    let target;
    let fallbackUsed = false;
    if (decCount === 0 || janCount === 0) {
      // Fallback: sum daily precipitation over each month
      const sumMonth = (y, m) => {
        const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(y, m, 1);
        const end = start.advance(1, 'month');
        return chirpsDaily.filterDate(start, end).sum().rename('precipitation');
      };
      target = sumMonth(2018, 12).add(sumMonth(2019, 1)).rename('precipitation');
      fallbackUsed = true;
      console.log(`Fallback: Using CHIRPS-Daily sums for target months`);
    } else {
      const dec2018 = ee.Image(dec2018Col.first()).select('precipitation');
      const jan2019 = ee.Image(jan2019Col.first()).select('precipitation');
      target = dec2018.add(jan2019).rename('precipitation');
    }

    // Build climatology seasons: Dec(Y)+Jan(Y+1), Y=2000..2018 (19 seasons)
    const years = ee.List.sequence(2000, 2018);
    const getMonthly = (y, m) =>
      chirpsMonthly
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(y, y, 'year'))
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(m, m, 'month'))
        .first()
        .select('precipitation');
    const seasonCol = ee.ImageCollection(
      years.map(function (y) {
        y = ee.Number(y);
        const decImg = getMonthly(y, 12);
        const janImg = getMonthly(y.add(1), 1);
        return ee.Image(decImg).add(ee.Image(janImg)).rename('precipitation')
          .set('season', ee.String('DJ').cat(y.format()));
      })
    );
    const seasonSize = await seasonCol.size().getInfo();
    console.log(`Seasons (Dec+Jan) 2000–2018: ${seasonSize}`);
    if (seasonSize === 0) {
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: pixel counts to detect C2
    const scale = 5500;
    const tgtCount = await target.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true,
    }).get('precipitation').getInfo();

    const climImg = seasonCol.mean().rename('precipitation');
    const climCount = await climImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true,
    }).get('precipitation').getInfo();

    console.log(`Valid pixels -> Target: ${tgtCount}, Climo: ${climCount}`);
    if (!tgtCount || !climCount || tgtCount === 0 || climCount === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: area means (mm over 2 months)
    const tgtMean = await target.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true,
    }).get('precipitation').getInfo();

    const climMean = await climImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true,
    }).get('precipitation').getInfo();

    if (!isFinite(tgtMean) || !isFinite(climMean)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = tgtMean - climMean;
    const ratio = climMean !== 0 ? (tgtMean / climMean) : null;

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Target mean (Dec2018+Jan2019) mm: ${tgtMean.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Climo mean (Dec+Jan 2000–2019) mm: ${climMean.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Diff (Target-Climo) mm: ${diff.toFixed(1)}; Ratio: ${ratio ? ratio.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);
    if (tgtMean < climMean) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
